title: Dispensing Schedule H1 & Schedule X Narcotics

intro.title: Dispensing Schedule H1 & Schedule X
intro.subtitle: Strict antibiotic tracking, narcotic controls, and automatic 2-year statutory register retention

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 3, Part 2: Dispensing Schedule H1 & Schedule X Narcotics. Schedule H1 antibiotics and psychotropic drugs carry stringent regulatory obligations under Indian pharmacy law.
When you add an item like Azithromycin 500mg into the cart, MediFlow flags the item with a prominent Schedule H1 badge and enforces statutory prescription capture.
The Doctor and Prescription panel is locked open. Select the registered doctor, verify their Medical Council registration, and input the patient's age and clinical slip reference.
MediFlow automatically attributes the dispensed batch to the statutory Schedule H1 ledger, maintaining an immutable audit log for the mandatory retention period.
The counter settlement completes safely with zero regulatory risk. In Part 3, discover how to manage your Doctor Master Directory and MCI Registration numbers.

outro.takeaway: Schedule H1 & X Dispensing: Eliminate audit vulnerability by enforcing mandatory prescriber tracking and automated dual statutory register logging.
